entities.summary: Phraya Phichai, or popularly known as Phraya Phichai Dap Hak (1741–1782) was a historic Siamese nobleman of Mon descent who served as a military leader under King Taksin of the Thonburi Kingdom. He legendarily became known for fighting with a sword in each hand until one was broken.
